titles.title: empty tiering → peripheral (mid) role resolves to the built-in mid default (claude sonnet), no clamp
empty tiering → critical (core) role resolves to the built-in core default (claude opus), no clamp
S010: brainstorm.decision.draft is peripheral → mid and is NOT floor-clamped
empty tiering BUT an explicit legacy shaperProvider still wins over the built-in defaults
a configured cheap tier wins over the built-in cheap default
roleTiers assigns a peripheral role a cheap tier with a concrete model
a mid CLI tier pins a concrete model (e.g. sonnet) that shaperModel alone cannot express
critical role assigned cheap is clamped UP to a core floor (clampedByFloor true) and uses the core tier model
peripheral role assigned cheap is NEVER clamped even with a core floor
byRepo roleTiers overrides the global roleTiers for the same role
an unknown RoleId falls to the built-in default tier (mid), non-critical, no throw
resolveShaperKind: roleResolved wins over repo/global/client
resolveShaperKind: a non-union roleResolved is coerced away (falls through the chain, never a REST path)
resolveShaperKind: legacy three-input callers resolve identically (roleResolved absent)
resolveProviderForRole memoizes per (role, repoPath) — repeated calls reuse the instance
resolveProviderForRole attaches a resolution record with the resolved tier/runner/model
resolveSummariser follows the summariser config (cheap tier), not the shaper/role tiering
empty tiering: tiers = DEFAULT_TIERS (source default), coreFloor = mid (default)
empty tiering: a critical role resolves to its core default (source taxonomy), unclamped
empty tiering: a peripheral role resolves to its taxonomy default (mid/cheap)
a configured tier model overrides the default and is marked source=config
a roleTiers override changes the effective tier and is marked source=override
a critical role overridden below coreFloor is clamped UP to the floor (clamped=true)
a peripheral role below coreFloor is NEVER clamped
a roleTiers key that is not a current taxonomy role is surfaced as a stale override
config dot-path helpers target the right keys
isTierName guards the tier union
ROLE_TIERS_PATH is the dotless map key (no role id appended)
nextRoleTiers keeps a dotted role id as a single FLAT key
nextRoleTiers merges into an existing map without disturbing other roles
nextRoleTiers with tier=null clears the override (sparse) and leaves siblings
nextRoleTiers does not mutate the input map
